prompt:
Identify the data structure used in this program.

Input:
Program: String matching program
response: The data structure used in this program is a linked list. The head of the linklist contains all elements that match with any given string, and each element has two pointers: one pointing to its next node (if it exists) or null if there are no more nodes after reaching end-of-linkedList; another pointer which points backward from itself until either an empty array/string is found at some point onwards or when finding "end" reached without matching anything.
